title: Add support for the kitty keyboard protocol
author: Munksgaard
body:
I'm developing a terminal application using [crossterm](https://github.com/crossterm-rs/crossterm), and I would like to use the number keys as modifiers instead of ctrl and alt. That can be done through the use of [`PushKeyboardEnhancementFlags`](https://docs.rs/crossterm/latest/crossterm/event/struct.PushKeyboardEnhancementFlags.html), whereupon my program will receive [`Release`](https://docs.rs/crossterm/latest/crossterm/event/enum.KeyEventKind.html#variant.Release) and [`Repeat`](https://docs.rs/crossterm/latest/crossterm/event/enum.KeyEventKind.html#variant.Repeat) events in addition to just [`Press`](https://docs.rs/crossterm/latest/crossterm/event/enum.KeyEventKind.html#variant.Press). However, it seems like that functionality is dependent on the terminal implementing the [kitty keyboard protocol](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/keyboard-protocol/), which alacritty doesn't.

Are there any plans for implementing such a feature, or is there a better way to achieve the same goal (arbitrary keys as modifiers) in alacritty?
